intro: The Meraki media unit perfectly blends style, simplicity, and functionality to modern Indian homes. Thoughtfully designed, it seamlessly fits into your living space, making it beautiful and practical.

features.title: Streamlined design for minimalist aesthetics
features.text: Say goodbye to clutter and hello to sophistication. The clean, sleek design of this media unit fits effortlessly into any modern living room, giving your space a fresh, uncluttered look that radiates calm and style.

features.title: Equipped with rubber wood legs for support
features.text: Built to last, these sturdy rubber wood legs offer a solid foundation, ensuring your media unit stands firm for years to come. It’s the perfect balance of style and strength.

features.title: Toughened glass doors for easy visibility
features.text: No more hiding your beautiful gadgets. The toughened glass doors let you display your media items with pride, giving you easy access while keeping everything neat and organised.

features.title: Multiple compartments for organised storage
features.text: Tired of searching through piles of cables or DVDs? With spacious compartments, this media unit lets you neatly store all your entertainment essentials, making everything easy to find and enjoy.

features.title: Knock-down construction for simple assembly
features.text: With its thoughtful knock-down design, assembly is a breeze – meaning you can spend less time building and more time relaxing in your newly upgraded space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
